item.title: Arrest: Former NFL player, coach at Arkansas High School investigated for child sex crimes
item.description: The Texarkana Arkansas Police Department has issued arrest warrants for a coach at Arkansas High School, following an investigation into allegations of sexual assault.

item.title: DHS confirms ICE agent shot, killed driver during spring break on South Padre Island
item.description: The Department of Homeland Security has confirmed to Border Report that special agents with U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement were involved in the shooting death of a man on South Padre Island in 2025 during a traffic stop last Spring Break in the South Texas border town.
